title: Chapter 224: 500,000 Star Destroyers
content:
Chapter 224: 500,000 Star Destroyers

In response to Naga's straightforward words, Wu Qing replied through Host No. 3: "As long as there is enough luck, our tribe has no shortage of high-star Zerg destroyers!"

"If there is a sufficient supply of luck beads, the Zerg destroyers here can easily upgrade one star!"

"How many Zerg destroyers we can provide, and how many star-level Zerg destroyers we can provide, depends on how many luck beads you can provide!"

After hearing this, Naga called her subordinates over and ordered: "Go! Collect all the luck beads!"

After the subordinates took the order and left, Naga said to Host No. 3: "Take the luck beads here and improve the strength of the Zerg destroyers here first!"

"I don't have the authority to mobilize more luck beads. I will explain the situation to the tribe and apply for resources!"

"I can't say how many resources I can apply for. When I have a specific number, I will go to the Zerg territory in person and talk to your lord about the hiring in detail!"

Naga is resolute in doing things, and Wu Qing likes this style very much.

The Naga army returned victorious and returned to the barracks with high morale.

Wu Qing discovered that there was a Naga spellcaster at the entrance of the barracks who had never been seen before, casting a large-scale Qiyun secret method on all personnel participating in the battle.

The Zerg destroyer was touched by the Qiyun secret method, and could feel a weak spiritual power flashing by, which seemed to be some kind of inspection secret method.

Host No. 3 and Naga 妶 were together, and they also needed to be checked.

"This is the weird detection secret method. On this battlefield, the murderous aura is too strong, and all kinds of negative auras are accumulating more and more, giving rise to some very strange and strange species!"

"Normally, it's okay, but problems are prone to occur when the war starts, so the participants must be checked!"

Naga 妶 explained to Host No. 3.

Wu Qing didn't expect that in some special environments, weirdness can also appear during the day.

However, the Zerg's spiritual will is a whole, and the body is just a shell, so it is not afraid, but you have to pay more attention to the abnormalities of other races around you.

Maybe this battle was too clean and quick, and ended quickly, leaving no chance for the weirdos. Everyone passed the inspection and entered the military camp.

When they arrived at the military camp, the luck beads that Naga ordered to be collected were delivered. This was a large number of luck beads, enough for more than 10,000 Zerg destroyers and Host No. 3 to upgrade by one level, and there was still more than half left.

Naga was a little curious about the upgrade of the Zerg, so she asked Host No. 3: "Can I stay and watch?"

Wu Qing did not object. The upgrade of the Zerg was the evolution of genes, which was not uncommon in this world.

"Of course!"

Host No. 3 distributed all the luck beads to the Zerg destroyers, and kept some for himself.

The system absorbed all the luck in the luck beads through the Zerg destroyers and Host No. 3, and converted them into gas resources. Wu Qing selected all the Zerg destroyers and Host No. 3 who absorbed the luck beads, and consumed resources to upgrade them all by one star.

The energy and gas resources of the system were transmitted through the Zerg network. All Zerg destroyers instantly secreted a large amount of organic matter, forming a giant pupa on the spot, which began to wriggle non-stop and grew to a certain extent.

Host No. 3 also formed a large pupa in the air to show his trust in Naga.

Naga felt very novel when she saw this scene.

In just a short while, all the Zerg broke out of the pupa, and the organic matter that formed the pupa was absorbed into their bodies again.

The stronger and larger high-star Zerg destroyers evolved and upgraded in this way and appeared in front of Naga.

Host No. 3 appeared again, with his strength upgraded to four stars and a slight increase in size, but the overall change was not great.

"No. 3, congratulations on your strength improvement!"

Naga smiled and congratulated Host No. 3.

The way the Zerg improves its strength is indeed strange, but there are too many strange things in this world, and Naga doesn't have any ideas. She is very satisfied with the result.

As long as you are willing to pay the price, you can get powerful battlefield assistance. This kind of transaction is fair.

As for the fact that the Zerg consumed all the luck beads, Naga did not mention it. Wu Qing was not polite. The extra luck was regarded as profit.

Seeing the immediate effect of the luck beads, Naga left the barracks without delay and went back to the tribe to apply for resources.

The next day, Host No. 3 led the upgraded Zerg Destroyer and followed Naga to participate in another battle with a scale of 100,000 troops.

This time, a special Naga observation team came to watch the battlefield performance of the Zerg Destroyer.

The upgraded Zerg Destroyer has 5,000 one-star, 5,000 two-star, 200 three-star and 20 four-star. They lived up to expectations and beat the 100,000 Skeleton Army without any chance of fighting back with a performance far exceeding yesterday.

Facing the fierce firepower of the Zerg destroyers, the Skeleton Army chose to retreat directly. Even with such a decisive retreat, they still lost most of their troops.

Such performance made the members of the Naga observation group very satisfied.

The Naga tribe's work style is the same as Naga's, which is swift and resolute. They immediately granted Naga's authority to mobilize resources and let her represent the Naga tribe to negotiate with Wu Qing in the Zerg territory.

At the same time, the Naga army secretly mobilized and prepared to take the initiative to launch a large-scale battle, taking advantage of this opportunity to eliminate a large number of the Skeleton's living forces.

The scale of this battle will be determined by the number of troops that the Zerg can provide.

Wu Qing did not expect that the Zerg would have such a rare opportunity just as they were heading out to the outside world because the attacks of the Zerg Destroyers just happened to restrain the Skeleton Tribe, the enemy of the Naga Tribe.

The large-scale war between the two major tribes participating in the main battle of the camp war is conducive to the Zerg quickly understanding the real war in this world.

You can also use the resources of the Naga tribe to vigorously demonstrate the strength of the Zerg, so as to gain the recognition of the Naga tribe from both strength and interests, which is very beneficial to the future development of the Zerg.

Of course, the most important thing is that through the trade between the Zerg and the Naga tribe, Wu Qing can obtain a lot of luck, thereby upgrading the star level of the existing main combat arms.

The Zerg calls itself a major tribe, and the first appearance of the goblin tribe, the army lineup cannot be too shabby, and must leave a deep impression on the world.

Naga soon met Wu Qing's Zerg clone again.

Naga Yi reported to Wu Qing the upper limit of her resources within the tribe, and explained the Naga tribe's demand for Zerg destroyers.

The Naga tribe was prepared to take advantage of the Zerg destroyers and make a ruthless attack at once. If a small number of Zerg destroyers were allowed to fight on the battlefield, the Skeleton Tribe would soon find a way to deal with them, and the role of the Zerg destroyers would not be so obvious.

In this world, there are all kinds of strange arms and magic, and there are always ways to deal with Zerg destroyers. With the ability of the Skeleton Tribe, it is not difficult to find such a way.

Therefore, the Naga tribe meant that within these limited resources, the Zerg tribe should provide as many Zerg destroyers as possible, and the strength level standard is that among 10,000 Zerg destroyers, 8,000 one-star, 1,800 two-star, 180 three-star and 20 four-star should be configured.

Wu Qing said that Zerg destroyers with higher star strengths could not be produced for the time being and it would take some time, so Naga Yi did not mention this matter.

Wu Qing asked the Queen to calculate how many tens of thousands of Zerg destroyers could be hatched by the luck beads provided by the Naga tribe and the energy resources mined by the Zerg from the underground world according to the standard stated by Naga.

The Queen is now equivalent to Wu Qing's exclusive biological intelligence brain, and the result came out immediately. According to the standard of the strength ratio of the Naga tribe, more than two million Zerg destroyers can be hatched in total.

The Queen knew Wu Qing's thoughts very well. When it said more than two million, Wu Qing would round it up to two million. As for how many tens of thousands, Wu Qing didn't want to know, just take it as profit.

Then there is the profit, which should be cut at least in half. This is the result of Wu Qing's desire to give the Naga tribe as many troops as possible, otherwise he would have to cut it even harder.

There is one million left, and Wu Qing thought that the Zerg tribe would have to pay a lot of energy resources. If these energy resources are produced into Zerg energy coins, the value will be great. I don't know how much profit he can get from the goblins.

The Zerg wanted to help the Naga tribe, but they couldn't suffer too much, so they cut it in half again, from one million to five hundred thousand.

Wu Qing restrained the urge to find another reason to cut it. The Zerg destroyers were in the Naga tribe, and fighting was also profitable, so they couldn't lose the big picture for the small.

Moreover, if the number of Zerg destroyers given to the Naga tribe was too small, the effect would be much smaller. If the Naga tribe couldn't gain an absolute advantage on the battlefield, the powerful ability of the Zerg tribe could not be reflected.

"If you can apply for the maximum limit of resources, I will provide you with fifty standard units, a total of five hundred thousand Zerg destroyers!"

Wu Qing paused for a long time before saying to Naga, who was looking forward to it.

"Really!?"

Naga seemed surprised, but also seemed to be unbelievable. The number given by Wu Qing exceeded her and the Naga tribe's expectations.

The Naga tribe actually had no idea about the strength of the Zerg. They roughly calculated the value of Zerg destroyers at different levels of strength based on the number of luck beads that Naga provided to Host No. 3 and the upgrade status of more than 10,000 Zerg destroyers.

The best result expected by the Naga tribe is that the Zerg is willing to provide the 200,000 Zerg destroyers they need. With these 200,000 Zerg destroyers, the Naga tribe can gain an absolute advantage on the battlefield.

The preparation and deployment of the Naga army is based on this standard, and the resource limit for Naga is also determined based on this data.

Now Wu Qing said that he could provide 500,000 Zerg destroyers, which greatly exceeded the expectations of the Naga tribe, so with Naga's scheming, it was difficult to hide her emotions at the negotiation table.
